arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import subprocess, sys, time, resource, os
for f in ['big1','big2','big3','big4','many']:
    t=time.time()
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','project/solver.py'],
                     stdin=open('/tmp/%s.json'%f,'rb'), stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    ru=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    print('%-6s %6.2fs rc=%d out=%d bytes  peak-child-rss=%d MiB' % (
        f, time.time()-t, p.returncode, len(p.stdout), ru.ru_maxrss//1024))
EOF
